description: This file declares the HeaderChecker class used for verifying header include dependencies and dependency chains in a build system, specifically for Chromium's build configuration. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and dependency management logic.

classes.name: HeaderChecker
classes.description: A class responsible for checking header include dependencies, dependency chains, and enforcing include rules within a build system.

classes.name: HeaderChecker::ChainLink
classes.description: Represents a link in a dependency chain, including target and whether the dependency is public.

classes.name: HeaderChecker::TargetInfo
classes.description: Stores information about a target, including whether it is public or generated.

methods.name: HeaderChecker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the header checker with build settings, targets, and check options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the header dependency check on specified targets, returning success or errors.

methods.name: CheckInclude
methods.description: Checks if a target can include a specific header file, adding errors if disallowed.

methods.name: IsDependencyOf
methods.description: Determines if one target is a dependency of another, considering dependency chains.

methods.name: MakeUnreachableError
methods.description: Creates an error message for disallowed include dependencies due to missing dependencies.
